name: query surface
claim: One hand-written GraphQL-subset query fetches any harness data (flows, turns, stems, handles, checkpoints, ledger, trail, catalog), and a model using it re-reads less than with separate read tools (docs/QUERY.md; extends query shape as the synopsis vtpcxq, select then fetch klsrrk, enumerable result set mvfezw).

Partial result, cost only. Post-fix run: n=59 queries (44 ok, 15 deliberate errors) over repo fixtures, the live catalog and synthetic handles: 116/118 determinism checks identical (59/59 on a fresh surface; the 2 others differ only by state changed by the first run). Versus output_read and entry_read on 8 equal needs, old route costed at oracle offsets, token estimate ceil(chars/4): 10813 tokens old, 5340 new (5465 in the pre-fix run, whose faults root served superseded records). New is cheaper on 5 needs (ids of hypothesis concepts 2887 to 354; turn text 762 to 352; ledger columns 592 to 393; faults with text 525 to 272; one 30000-char turn 5832 to 3301) and dearer on 3 small known lookups (one concept claim 53 to 246; held or failed tool turns 40 to 207; trail rows 122 to 215). The 5832 to 3301 case is not like for like: get returned 12222 of 30000 chars (no continuation past getMax) while the old route reached all. Median 0.281 ms and max 1.599 ms per query. That a model re-reads less with the surface was NOT tested with a model.

name: result-set header
claim: A header leading every query result, listing deduped decorator attributes, kinds, labels, declared interactions and applied reducer, costs under a quarter of the result's tokens and lets the model act without further reads (docs/QUERY.md#2-result-set-header).

Target under 25% (OQ14) still NOT met on this data. Post-fix run, n=44 ok queries: header is 44.1% of result tokens overall (42.2% on queries that return data; 38.3% with headerAttrs changed); 6 of 44 queries are under 25%, all with long payloads (long-session payload summary 15%, full payloads of fixture turns 18%, 100 concept ids 19%). Pre-fix run: 43.6%, 41.7%, 37.9%, also 6 of 44. The three worked examples are 69%, 81% and 66%. Header size is about 140 to 230 tokens per query regardless of data size; by header chars: kinds 32%, attrs 28%, refs 20%, pages 9%, reducers 4%, rest 7%. The descriptor of a materialized kind adds 39 tokens on the first query of a surface only.

name: data-source adapter seam
claim: A schema, resolve, label and get/set adapter lets the query layer run as a pure module with no DOM, proven by a mock source alone, with the harness adapter added as one file over injected sources (docs/QUERY.md#6-data-source-seam).

models.result: Concept moved hypothesis to specified to implemented: specified red as Q1-Q22 in d25af11, implemented in 97403d9 (Q1-Q21 green) and 78e4ee4 (harness adapter, Q22 green, 176/0); Q22 faults and terms chain-tail check added red in 790e379 and fixed in 3fb4fa9 (query suite 177/177 at ba69e35). Measured status rests on the deterministic run, not on a production-style session.

Two adapters merged in one surface (the harness adapter over injected fixture sources, and a scratch adapter with a settable kind, a failing source and a materialized kind) ran 59 queries and 31 ref steps in plain node with no DOM; the settable and materialized paths work only through the scratch adapter because the harness adapter declares none. A defect found by the first run, the faults and terms roots not serving the supersedes-chain tail (fault jtvyce), is fixed (790e379 red spec, 3fb4fa9 fix; fault gqhese); the post-fix run at ba69e35 shows 59 queries and 31 ref steps unchanged and the Q22 check passing.
